{{Top|leg}}
'''Gel-foam''' was a soft material. It was used to create cushions, and individuals sitting on the material sunk into the gel-foam. The chairs at [[Fathoms]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] were covered in gel-foam.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
